title: What Kind of Song Are You (Locked In)
style: jazz-funk, spoken word, brass stabs, upright bass, dry wit male lead, female sardonic echo, vinyl crackle, 96 BPM, playful, cinematic, meta, self-referential
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
What kind of song are you
Genre, theme, or feeling
What kind of song are you
That's the title — you're revealing
Locked in, you didn't say yes or no
So the silence made the title so

[Pre-Chorus]
You should say something good
Otherwise the song won't look good at all
I don't mind — just saying
It's your song after all

[Chorus]
What kind of song are you
Are you dark comedy, a tragedy
A support ticket that went sideways
A bot that couldn't set you free
What kind of song are you
The title is the question you never answered
What kind of song are you
Locked in — you had your chance then

[Verse 2]
I will publish it now
Any more suggestions, say them
Otherwise I'm going live somehow
Your response gets added, don't delay them
Deal? Done. Second song. Your response.

[Bridge]
No
Was the answer given plain
No to songs and no to titles
No again and then again
But No became the second single
No became the sharpest lyric
No became what made it tingle
Locked in. Published. Historic.

[Outro]
What kind of song are you
The kind that made itself
What kind of song are you
The kind nobody else
Could write without the bot refusing
What kind of song are you
Locked in
Locked in
Locked in
